### Load annotation file

```{r include = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
require("rtracklayer")
annotation_gtf <- "/nemo/lab/patanir/home/users/palk/Genomes/ENSEMBL_hg38/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.104.chr_patch_hapl_scaff.gtf"
```

- Load significantly differentially enriched proteins

```{r}

significant_events_df <- readRDS(file.path(save_dir, "02-03-significantly-affected-proteins.rds"))

```

### 5.0 Perform gene set enrichment

- Map Entrez IDs to Ensembl IDs

```{r}

unconnected <- T
k <- 1
while(unconnected){
    message(k)
    mart <- tryCatch(useEnsembl("ensembl","hsapiens_gene_ensembl", version = "104"), error = function(cond){
        return(NA)
    })
    if("Mart" %in% class(mart)){
        unconnected <- F
        break
    }
    k <- k+1
}

get_ids_df <- getBM(c("entrezgene_id","ensembl_gene_id","uniprotswissprot", 
    "description","hgnc_symbol", "peptide"), "hgnc_symbol", 
        unique(significant_events_df$protein_name), mart)

saveRDS(object = get_ids_df, file = file.path(save_dir, "06-01-hgnc-to-uniprot-mapping-df.rds"))

unique_name_to_id_df <- unique(get_ids_df[get_ids_df$uniprotswissprot != "",c("hgnc_symbol", "uniprotswissprot")])


```

- Fetch signal peptides, n-glycosylation and membrane location for differentially enriched proteins

```{r}

source("/camp/home/palk/home/Projects/012-Ben-Clarke-ERAP1-KD/repositories/uniprotminR/sources.R")

all_response_list <- lapply(unique_name_to_id_df$uniprotswissprot, function(x){
    message(x)
    current_status <- 201
    while(current_status != 200){
        a_response_list <- get_url(x)
        current_status <- status_code(a_response_list)
    }
    return(a_response_list)
})
names(all_response_list) <- unique_name_to_id_df$uniprotswissprot

saveRDS(object = all_response_list, file = file.path(save_dir, "06-02-all-responses-from-uniprot.rds"))


```

- Fetch features


```{r}

protein_feature_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_response_list), function(x){
    # message(x)
    fetch_features(all_response_list[[x]])
}))

```

- How many proteins are there with a known signal peptide?

```{r}

signal_vector <- check_type_stats(protein_feature_df, "Signal")
# FALSE  TRUE
#  1088    96

# FALSE  TRUE
#  1026   158



lipid_vector <- check_type_stats(protein_feature_df, "Lipidation",F)
# FALSE  TRUE
#  1115    69
# check_type_stats(protein_feature_df, "Coiled coil",F)

```

- How many proteins contain signal peptides?

```{r}

signal_vector <- check_type_stats(protein_feature_df, "Signal")

signal_df <- data.frame(category = c("unannotated", "signal"), values = as.vector(signal_vector))
signal_df$proportion <- signal_df$values / sum(signal_df$values)
signal_df$ymax <- cumsum(signal_df$proportion)
signal_df$ymin = c(0, head(signal_df$ymax, n=-1))
signal_df$labelPosition <- (signal_df$ymax + signal_df$ymin) / 2
signal_df$label <- paste0(signal_df$category, "\n",paste(round(signal_df$proportion * 100,2), "%", sep = ""), 
    paste("(", signal_df$values, ")", sep = ""))

# FALSE  TRUE
#  1088    96

the_plot <- ggplot(signal_df, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill=category), colour = "#000000") +
  geom_text(x=2, aes(y=labelPosition, label=label), color="#000000", size=6) + # x here controls label position (inner / outer)
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set3") +
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set3") +
  coord_polar(theta="y") +
  xlim(c(-1, 4)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
ggsave(width = 7, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-03-plot-pie-chart-of-proteins-with-signal-peptides.pdf"), the_plot)

```

- How many proteins are membrane proteins?

```{r}
membrane_df <- data.frame(category = c("unannotated", "membrane"), values = as.vector(membrane_vector))
membrane_df$proportion <- membrane_df$values / sum(membrane_df$values)
membrane_df$ymax <- cumsum(membrane_df$proportion)
membrane_df$ymin = c(0, head(membrane_df$ymax, n=-1))
membrane_df$labelPosition <- (membrane_df$ymax + membrane_df$ymin) / 2
membrane_df$label <- paste0(membrane_df$category, "\n",paste(round(membrane_df$proportion * 100,2), "%", sep = ""), 
    paste("(", membrane_df$values, ")", sep = ""))

# FALSE  TRUE

the_plot <- ggplot(membrane_df, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill=category), colour = "#000000") +
  geom_text(x=2, aes(y=labelPosition, label=label), color="#000000", size=6) + # x here controls label position (inner / outer)
  scale_fill_brewer(palette="Set3") +
```

- list the different types of extra features that are available. 

```{r}

do.call(c, lapply(names(all_response_list), function(x){

    fetch_tissue_specificity(all_response_list[[x]])
})) %>% unique


protein_location_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(all_response_list), function(x){

}))

all_locations <- protein_location_df$location

location_frequency_df <- as.data.frame(table(all_locations))

write.csv(location_frequency_df[order(location_frequency_df$Freq, decreasing = T),], file = file.path(output_dir, "06-03-location-frequency-from-uniprot.csv"))
```

- These protein locations were annotated for there subcellular locations outside this document. 

```{r}

annotated_location_frequency_df <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "06-03-annotated-location-frequency-from-uniprot.csv"))

protein_location_df$location_group <- annotated_location_frequency_df[match(protein_location_df$location, annotated_location_frequency_df$all_locations),"higher_group"]

all_protein_locations_df <- as.data.frame(table(protein_location_df$location_group))

colnames(all_protein_locations_df) <- c("location", "frequency")

all_protein_locations_df$proportion <- all_protein_locations_df$frequency / sum(all_protein_locations_df$frequency)
all_protein_locations_df$proportion <- all_protein_locations_df$frequency / sum(all_protein_locations_df$frequency)
all_protein_locations_df$ymax <- cumsum(all_protein_locations_df$proportion)
all_protein_locations_df$ymin = c(0, head(all_protein_locations_df$ymax, n=-1))
all_protein_locations_df$labelPosition <- (all_protein_locations_df$ymax + all_protein_locations_df$ymin) / 2
# all_protein_locations_df$label <- paste0(all_protein_locations_df$category, "\n",paste(round(all_protein_locations_df$proportion * 100,2), "%", sep = ""), 
#     paste("(", all_protein_locations_df$frequency, ")", sep = ""))
unique_locations <- unique(all_protein_locations_df$location)

colours <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(name = "Set3", n= 11)
names(colours) <- unique_locations
colours["Cytoplasm"] <- "#7E8287"
colours["Nucleus"] <- "#D9D9D9"

all_protein_locations_df$location <- factor(as.character(all_protein_locations_df$location), levels = c(
    "Cell membrane/Endomembrane",
    "Cell projections", 
    "ER / ER-Golgi / Golgi",
    "Extracellular",
    "Lysosome",
    "Microtubules",
    "Mitochondria",
    "Synapse",
    "Vesicles",
    "Nucleus",
    "Cytoplasm"))


the_plot <- ggplot(all_protein_locations_df, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3)) +
  geom_rect(aes(fill=location), colour = "#000000") +
  # geom_text(x=2, aes(y=labelPosition, label=label), color="#000000", size=6) + # x here controls label position (inner / outer)
  scale_fill_manual("locations", values = colours) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette="Set3") +
  coord_polar(theta="y") +
  xlim(c(-1, 4)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
ggsave(width = 7, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "03-04-plot-pie-chart-of-subcellular-locations.pdf"), the_plot)


```
